'''Chapter 155''' is titled "Pirate Sir Crocodile".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 23: "Seeya Later, Stupid Marines!!"

Having found a boat off [[Mirror Ball Island]], [[Jango]] throws a parting taunt at all the [[Marines]] that remained ignorant of his real identity.

==Short Summary==
[[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] explains [[Baroque Works]] and [[Crocodile]] is seen as a hero in [[Arabasta]].

==Long Summary==
In [[Arabasta]], the [[Seven Warlords of the Sea|Warlord]] [[Crocodile]] is seen as a hero. Indeed we see him helping in the fight against pirates and be the subject of adoration by the people of Arabasta. Even [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]]'s father king [[Nefertari Cobra|Cobra]] thanks him for his help.

Back on the [[Going Merry]], Vivi explains these facts to the others. Arabasta people cannot imagine that the person who they see as a hero, is the one that is currently ruining their country. As a consequence, they have to stop the rebellion and then get rid of [[Baroque Works]]. When asked by [[Usopp]] about how the organization works, Vivi tells them of the pyramidal hierarchy and the main officer agents. But for Crocodile to take over Arabasta means that all the top agents are together somewhere in Vivi's country.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Crocodile]] is seen clearly for the first time, and it is revealed that he is seen as a hero to the people of [[Arabasta]].
*Crocodile's title card says that his former bounty: {{B}}81,000,000. Strangely, Igaram said Crocodile's former bounty was {{B}}80,000,000.
*Crocodile demonstrates [[Logia|intangibility]] and the [[Suna Suna no Mi|power to create sand storms]], further implying he has a [[Devil Fruit]].
*[[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] explains the [[Baroque Works]] system.
*Vivi reveals that she believes all the Official Agents of Baroque Works will descend onto Alabasta to complete Crocodile's ultimate plan.
*This is the first chapter of the [[Arabasta Arc]].
